look: Crystal Ghoul, a D-rank GKOM variant from the Husks family: fast crouching ghoul with crystal teeth and claws. Family anatomy: undead male husks of GKOM victims, gaunt grey flesh, black veins, torn clothing, the orb where the heart was. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystals crust its joints and run along the spine; about a quarter of the body crystallised; the crystals are bone-white crystal. A tennis-ball-sized GKOM core orb, dark amber with visible cracks, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, modest shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
